status: Complete native source quartet and QA; coordinator export/integration pending
nativeArtPolicy: Each selected raw and master is byte-identical to its built-in output. No alpha cleanup, painting, recoloring, source cropping, per-pose scaling or source padding. QA/export composites are separate.
semanticContract: idle/walk-a/carry-or-work/walk-b. No real domain actor or rendered scene placement exists. Work uses the original broom for noncombat sweeping. Do not invent caretaker actors or confuse this living civilian with the combat gravekeeper.
sourceAnomalyResolution: Original four-cell board repeated idle for work and the same step in both walk cells. Source identity is preserved while work becomes functional and two walking contacts become opposite.
palettePolicy: Preserve warm tan elderly skin, silver-gray hair, warm-gray hood, cream gown, dark-gray inner hem, brown rope belt and boots, ochre belt tags, dark-gray watering can, golden straw broom.

idle.review: Gray hood over silver-gray hair, elderly tan face, cream gown with dark-gray hem, brown rope belt and two ochre tags. Screen-left hand carries one gray watering can; screen-right holds one straw broom. Two planted brown boots.

walk-a.review: Screen-right boot swings forward with raised toe and broad underside visible; screen-left boot is flat and supports weight. Broom lifted clear and can retained by original hand. Not mirrored.

carry-or-work.review: Clear functional single-handed sweep: screen-right forearm extends diagonal broom, straw head contacts implied ground at boot-sole height; eyes look down, upper body leans. Screen-left hand draws original watering can up to hip. Exactly two hands and one of each tool.

walk-b.review: Opposite contacts from walk-a: screen-right boot flat and supporting, screen-left boot tilted with raised heel. Original can and broom stay in their original hands. Same facing, not mirrored.
